title: First Proper Smile
desc: Eyes bright, cheeks round, and a gummy grin that melted us completely — your first real social smile.
story: Four weeks old and it finally happened. A real, intentional, looking-right-at-us smile. Mum was doing silly voices and pulling funny faces during tummy time when you looked up and grinned. A proper, gummy, full-face grin. She screamed for Dad. He came running, and we both crouched down to your level, and you smiled again, as if you knew exactly what you had just done to us.
